What does it take to bring down the Mob? In this special compilation episode of Inside the American Mob, travel back to 1983 when Rudolph "Rudy" Giuliani, the US Attorney for the Southern District of New York and future mayor of New York City, sets out to take down the Mafia Commission in New York. Meanwhile, in Las Vegas, Operation Strawman, a multi-year effort by the FBI and US Department of Justice, aims to end the mafia's silent control of Las Vegas casinos.
